newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia Jan-Aug aluminium output 1.88 mln tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Russia Jan-Aug aluminium output 1.88 mln tonnes.

text.p: Russian output of primary aluminium over January-August was 1.88 million tonnes, a 2.3 percent rise on 1995 levels, Kontsern Alyuminiy, a producers' association, said on Tuesday.
Alyuminiy deputy development director Galina Stelmakova said Krasnoyarsk led with over 520,000 tonnes over the first eight months of 1996, up five percent on year-ago levels.
Bratsk produced over 493,000 tonnes over the same period, down 3.7 percent year-on-year, she said.
AO Krasnoyarsky Alyuminievy Zavod's August output was 64,900 tonnes, up from 64,700 tonnes in July.
AO Bratsky Alyuminievy Zavod August production edged up to 64,900 tonnes from 63,300 in July.
